newsitem.title: USA: Southern Energy opens Dallas office.
newsitem.headline: Southern Energy opens Dallas office.

text.p: Southern Co said Monday its Southern Energy Inc unit has named Curtis Griffin as regional accounts manager in its newly opened business development office in the Dallas-Fort Worth area.
Griffin comes to Southern Energy from Texas Utilities Co, where he worked as a sales executive in marketing and sales operations.

In addition to the new Dallas-Fort Worth office and its headquarters in Atlanta, Southern Energy operates U.S. business development offices in San Francisco, Vancouver, Wash., Boston, Concord, N.H., and Columbus, Ohio.

"Southern Energy is opening offices in key electricity markets of the United States to establish a presence and pursue opportunities in the rapidly developing power marketing business," the company said. "Our goal is to become one of the top energy marketing organizations in the nation."
